**What needs to be done**
A clear, specific task that can be completed in one session.

**Context**
Why this matters and where to find the relevant code.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] What needs to be working/visible when done
- [ ] Tests written or updated
- [ ] No existing functionality broken

**Relevant files**
- `path/to/file.kt` — what to change
- `path/to/test.kt` — where to add tests

**Difficulty**
- [ ] Easy (< 2 hours)
- [ ] Medium (2-6 hours)
- [ ] Hard (6+ hours)

**Component**
- [ ] Android UI
- [ ] Server / API
- [ ] Dashboard
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests
